_file_summary: Central structural rulebook: how every module series lays out its templated page elements (header, titles, menu, footer, scripts), resolved through a four-tier inheritance cascade (defaults -> subject -> base series -> year level). Tracks the amalgamated 11-field model: 6 scalar fields and 5 cross-page PATTERN fields whose value is an {overview, lesson[, final]} object. Fields are stored as bare values; a field absent at a tier is inherited from the tier above. All historical vote/provenance data (status, winning_module, exceptions) lives in the source archive registry, not here.

_meta.purpose: Style-anchor registry (cascade). For a new module, resolve each field from the lowest tier that specifies it: level.delta -> base_rules -> subject_rules -> defaults. Works with Tag_Variation_Catalogue.json: once parsed tags are mapped to HTML entities, these rules dictate how the templated elements are laid out.
_meta.stage1_note: CONVERTER_V2 Stage-1 optimised copy. Disagreements were already adjudicated at source (most-recent-module rule); this file keeps only the winning rule values. See STAGE1_DATA_CHANGELOG.md.
_meta.field_model: AMALGAMATED model: scalar fields hold one value per module; PATTERN fields (module_code, h1_count, menu_button_tooltip, menu_type, footer_links) hold a structured value object keyed by page type {overview, lesson[, final]}, so the cross-page pattern resolves and is compared as one unit. This replaces the earlier split into _overview/_lesson/_final sub-fields (idoc_host_overview/_lesson are now a single idoc_host; etc.).

excluded_fields.stickyNav: Templating error copied across modules — never emit.
excluded_fields.embedded_css: Inline styles are a last-resort manual fix; generated modules must use predefined CSS classes, so this is not tracked.

resolver.walk: level.delta -> base_rules -> subject_rules -> defaults (first hit wins)
resolver.find_nearest_module: 'members' under each level lists existing sibling codes; a new module inherits the level's resolved rules.
resolver.pattern_fields: A pattern field resolves the WHOLE {overview, lesson[, final]} object together.

universal_fields._doc: ROUND 238 (Dev-Feedback R1 Family A — module SCCH302, the first module of a brand-new subject). Some registry tiers were MINED as the literal string 'n/a' (the '1-10 Science' subject_rules, the Blended-Literacy CODE base_rules, the ConnectED CEDT1 delta) — a mining-failed marker, never a real output value: the page shipped body class='n/a' and a script URL of https://n/a.desire2learn.com/…, which loads UNSTYLED. TWO RULES, both read by ModuleResolver.Resolve: (1) UNKNOWN-LITERAL SKIP — while walking the cascade, a tier field whose value is in unknown_literals (or a pattern object any of whose sub-values is) is NOT overlaid, so the nearest REAL tier — ultimately the defaults tier above — keeps that field; a final sweep guarantees no unknown literal can ever survive into resolved rules from ANY source (the Majority registry carries 24 of them too). (2) EVIDENCE FLOOR — a matched base whose registry members have fewer than min_evidence gold-built modules in Module_Structure_Index (the on-disk gold library index; the module's own code counts when it is itself indexed) is an untrustworthy mined group WHOLESALE: every field listed below resolves from the defaults tier instead, and run.registryDefaultsApplied is set (MenuBuilder's first-in-series default label row keys on it). Measured 2026-07-30: the SCCH base's one member SCCH301 has NO gold on disk (evidence 0 → floor fires → SCCH302 gets container-fluid / tekura / footer-nav / level='' / full-code+decimal chips / tabs+simplified menus); CEDT (evidence ≥2) and SCFUN (evidence 1) keep their real mined values, with only their literal 'n/a' fields healed by rule 1. Env toggle: SKELDEFAULT_OFF reverts BOTH rules (the pre-238 plain overlay).

template_deltas._doc: ROUND 357 (the autonomous loop's session-19 Round 1, 2026-09-17 — the diff miner's first chrome class, DIFF_QUEUE F15 / F14: the #module-code chip's PRESENCE). A FIFTH, optional cascade tier at a base or a level: {"<template_type>": {field: value}} — Standard / Inquiry / Fundamentals / Bilingual, the 01-Finalized_Modules_ folder names — overlaid AFTER the level delta (so it outranks it) when the module's template type is known from Module_Structure_Index.module_meta (the same index the evidence floor reads); a module the index does not know gets NO template delta and keeps the level's value, exactly as before this round. WHY: a mined level can hold two template families the human built differently — the BLL1 level is the seven INQUIRY parents (BLL110 … BLL170: no chip in 6 of their 7 golds) plus their 56 STANDARD children (a chip on every page); CEDO1 is CEDO102 (Inquiry, no chip) beside CEDO105 (Standard, chip); the EXPFUN base is five Inquiry modules (no chip) beside EXPFUN07 (Standard, chip). Pattern fields resolve as WHOLE objects here too; unknown literals are skipped as in every tier. Measured: outputs/_measure_r357_chip.py.

code_prefix_deltas._doc: ROUND 427 (the autonomous loop's session 33 Round 5, 2026-09-22 — the diff miner's chrome facts F3 / F8: the lesson chip's FORM). A registry level is keyed by the hundreds digit, but a family's convention can turn on the TENS digit: measured over every BLL gold lesson page (outputs/_s33_r5 chip census), BLL11x / 12x / 13x carry the padded chip (01), BLL14x / 15x / 16x the DECIMAL chip (1.0 — 7 / 7, 5 / 6, 7 / 7 modules) under the BLL1 level whose delta says padded-number, BLL21x–25x decimal, and BLL26x / 27x the PADDED chip (6 / 6, 6 / 6) under the BLL2 level whose base says decimal; BLL17x is 5 padded / 2 decimal and stays. `prefix_deltas` is a SIXTH, optional tier at a base or a level — {"<code prefix>": {field: value}} — the LONGEST matching prefix wins, overlaid after the level and template deltas by ModuleResolver.Resolve; an object-valued field is merged PER KEY so a row names only the key that differs (module_code.lesson) and the overview form and the Inquiry parents' template-delta `absent` stand. Class: 31 modules / ≈ 62 lesson pages; gate-neutral by design (the chip is TEXT inside the same div#module-code > h1 — the skeleton ignores it; the miner's chrome facts F3 / F8 are the verifier). Env PREFIXDELTA_OFF or enabled false restores the level's value for every module.

module_code_to_level.rule: The hundreds digit of the numeric part of a module code gives the phase/level; letter prefixes override.

_how_to_edit.template_override: Edit <subject>.bases.<base>.template_deltas.<TemplateType>.<field> or <subject>.bases.<base>.levels.<level>.template_deltas.<TemplateType>.<field> — overlaid after the level delta for modules whose Module_Structure_Index template_type matches (round 357).
_how_to_edit.remove_override: Delete the field at that tier to inherit from above.
_how_to_edit.pattern_value: For pattern fields the value is an object, e.g. footer_links.value = {overview:'next+home', lesson:'prev+next+home', final:'prev+home'}.

tracked_fields_described.template_phase: Lesson/year-level phase band. Assigned per year level by design.
tracked_fields_described.body_class: CSS class on <body>. e.g. 'container-fluid','container-fluid inquiry','container-fluid fundamentals'.
tracked_fields_described.idoc_host: iDoc script host — a single value per module. Always 'tekura' (production). The historical tekuradev dev/prod artefact was normalised to 'tekura' in Stage 1; the engine must always emit the tekura host.
tracked_fields_described.level_attr: The level attribute on <html>. 'empty' (present but blank), a code like 'ech'/'prm', or 'absent'.
tracked_fields_described.module_code: How the page code is rendered, as a cross-page PATTERN {overview, lesson}. Values per page: 'full-code','decimal','padded-number','free-text','absent'.
tracked_fields_described.h1_count: Number of <h1> per page, as a PATTERN {overview, lesson}. Overview often carries a second title h1.
tracked_fields_described.menu_button_tooltip: Whether the menu button shows a tooltip, as a PATTERN {overview, lesson}.
tracked_fields_described.menu_type: Navigation menu style, as a PATTERN {overview, lesson}. 'simplified','tabs','none'.
tracked_fields_described.footer_class: CSS class on the footer nav. e.g. 'footer-nav','footer-nav inquiry-nav'.
tracked_fields_described.footer_links: Footer nav links, as a PATTERN {overview, lesson, final}. Classic rule: overview='next+home', lesson='prev+next+home', final='prev+home'.
tracked_fields_described.acknowledgements: Always 'yes' — the acknowledgements block is generated for EVERY module (team policy, locked 2026-06-12; a non-decision). Some historical modules lacked the block; that variation is deliberately not carried into this ruleset. PLACEMENT (team Updated Decision, locked 2026-06-12): the acknowledgements/copyright block ALWAYS sits at the BOTTOM OF THE VERY FIRST PAGE (the -00 overview page — or the module's only page for single-file modules), as div.acks placed AFTER (outside) the #footer div, accordion structure. NEVER on the last page or any other lesson page, for ALL module types. Any historical module or document placing acknowledgements/copyright on the final page is superseded and must be ignored.
tracked_fields_described.page_model: Output page model, derived from the finished corpus (hold-out validation finding, 2026-06-11). 'multi-file': [LESSON n]/[PAGE]/[end page] boundaries produce one HTML file each. 'single-file': the whole module is ONE HTML file regardless of page tags in the template (Fundamentals, ConnectED landing, TWHK, some BLL anchor modules); page tags become in-page section breaks. 'page_model_exceptions' lists members deviating from the level's majority.
